resolution: Firmware defect in the chart renderer. Applied vendor patch 4.2.1.

title: Lane out of service at peak
description: Unit reboots by itself a few times a day, always around the busiest hours.
resolution: Faulty power supply under load. Replaced the unit with no repeat over the following week.

title: End of day batch did not complete
description: The run failed silently and was only noticed when the morning figures did not balance.
resolution: Disk exhausted on the batch host mid write. Cleared space, added an alert and reran cleanly.

title: Settlement file rejected by clearing
description: Submission bounced. The totals at the end of it did not agree with the body.
resolution: Trailing record count mismatch caused by a duplicated entry. Deduplicated and resubmitted.

title: Console blanking intermittently
description: Image stalls and the vessel symbol stops moving, though position is clearly still changing.
resolution: Loose display cable at the bulkhead connector. Reseated and secured, no further dropouts.

title: Printing stops partway through a sale
description: Paper feeds a few lines then gives up, leaving the customer with half a slip.
resolution: Paper sensor dirty and reporting empty. Cleaned and recalibrated.

title: Authorisation success rate dropped
description: Support is fielding complaints that the payment page hangs and then gives up.

title: Authorisation success rate dropped
description: Customers say payment spins and then fails, and a retry usually works on the second attempt.
resolution: Upstream acquirer degraded. Failed over to the secondary route and rates recovered immediately.

title: Lane out of service at peak
description: Screen stops accepting input at the worst moment and the sale has to be started again.
resolution: Thermal shutdown from blocked vents behind the counter. Relocated and cleaned.

title: Elevated decline rate on card payments
description: A fifth of attempts are bouncing back, where it is normally a rounding error.
resolution: Expired certificate on the acquirer link. Renewed and redeployed, success rate normalised.

title: Online availability showing items that are sold out
description: The nightly transfer arrived hours late, so morning picking worked from stale numbers.
resolution: Message queue backed up behind a poison message. Removed it and replayed the remainder.

title: Console blanking intermittently
description: Picture freezes mid update. Everything else on the bridge carries on as normal.

title: False positives spiking on new rule
description: Far more legitimate transactions are being held for review than usual since yesterday.

title: No receipt at end of transaction
description: Paper feeds a few lines then gives up, leaving the customer with half a slip.
resolution: Paper sensor dirty and reporting empty. Cleaned and recalibrated.

title: End of day batch did not complete
description: Job died in the middle and had to be picked up again from where it gave out.
resolution: Downstream schema change not applied in our mapping. Updated the mapping and reran.

title: Overtemperature warning during evening peak
description: Unit runs hotter than the others on the same bus under identical load.
resolution: Radiator fins heavily fouled. Cleaned and flushed to restore rated cooling capacity.

title: Fuel pressure fluctuating on auxiliary engine
description: Output is uneven under steady demand, with no alarm raised.
resolution: Lift pump diaphragm perished. Renewed the pump and confirmed steady supply pressure.

title: Unit running warmer than its neighbours
description: Thermal margin has been shrinking week on week and nobody can point at a cause.
resolution: Blocked airflow from vegetation growth against the enclosure. Cleared and trimmed back.

title: Counts disagree between systems
description: The website is offering products the shelf does not actually have, and customers arrive to collect nothing.
resolution: Message queue backed up behind a poison message. Removed it and replayed the remainder.

title: Lane out of service at peak
description: Cuts out repeatedly once the shop fills up, never when it is quiet.
resolution: Thermal shutdown from blocked vents behind the counter. Relocated and cleaned.

title: Review queue backing up
description: Overnight job still running well into the morning, leaving downstream reports delayed.
resolution: Threshold misconfigured during deployment. Corrected and validated against the holdout set.

title: Receipt printer not responding
description: No paper comes through even though everything else about the sale worked.
resolution: Printer driver incompatible with the latest POS release. Rolled back the driver.

title: Lane out of service at peak
description: It gives up under pressure. Quiet mornings are fine, Saturday afternoon is not.
resolution: Thermal shutdown from blocked vents behind the counter. Relocated and cleaned.

title: Unexpected breaker trip on feeder
description: Breaker opened on its own. Walked the route and found nothing wrong.
resolution: Current transformer wiring reversed on one phase after maintenance. Corrected and tested.

title: Console blanking intermittently
description: Screen locks up for around thirty seconds then returns on its own, several times per watch.
resolution: Firmware defect in the chart renderer. Applied vendor patch 4.2.1.

title: Printing stops partway through a sale
description: No paper comes through even though everything else about the sale worked.
resolution: Worn feed roller slipping under load. Replaced the roller assembly.

title: End of day batch did not complete
description: Clearing would not take the submission, so nothing landed where it should have.
resolution: Disk exhausted on the batch host mid write. Cleared space, added an alert and reran cleanly.

title: Transformer temperature trending high
description: It is noticeably warmer to stand next to than the one beside it, carrying the same current.
resolution: Two cooling fans had failed. Replaced both, temperature returned to its normal profile within the hour.

title: Unit running warmer than its neighbours
description: Gradual rise on the trend, small each day, obvious across a month.
resolution: Two cooling fans had failed. Replaced both, temperature returned to its normal profile within the hour.

title: Telemetry gap from remote site
description: Trend shows holes in the record overnight that filled themselves in by morning.
resolution: Radio link degraded by weather. Repointed the antenna and improved the margin.

title: Unit running warmer than its neighbours
description: Control room sees the figure drifting upward and not recovering during the quiet hours.
resolution: Radiator fins heavily fouled. Cleaned and flushed to restore rated cooling capacity.

title: Elevated decline rate on card payments
description: More transactions than normal are being turned away, with no pattern by card type or issuer.
resolution: Connection pool exhausted after a traffic spike. Raised the pool size and added backpressure.

title: Printing stops partway through a sale
description: Staff hand over a torn stub because the machine quit in the middle of it.
resolution: Worn feed roller slipping under load. Replaced the roller assembly.

title: Receipt printer not responding
description: Staff hand over a torn stub because the machine quit in the middle of it.
resolution: Worn feed roller slipping under load. Replaced the roller assembly.

title: Telemetry gap from remote site
description: Intermittent loss of contact with the outstation, several short gaps through the evening.
resolution: Failing media converter at the site end. Swapped the unit and the gaps stopped.

title: Chart display freezing on bridge console
description: Goes black for a moment, then paints itself back in as if nothing happened.
resolution: Firmware defect in the chart renderer. Applied vendor patch 4.2.1.

title: Overtemperature warning during evening peak
description: Sits several degrees above where it has historically run, with load unchanged.

title: Telemetry gap from remote site
description: Data stopped arriving during the night shift and backfilled automatically once the link recovered.
resolution: Radio link degraded by weather. Repointed the antenna and improved the margin.
